instructions: Map these semantic events to the existing analytics and billing system.
Define eligibility, counting unit, assignment, exposure and outcome window before launch.
Replace null project decisions before using the contract in production.
Use payment-provider and server records as the paid-outcome source of truth.
Do not send raw payment details, passwords, sensitive free text or unnecessary personal data.

common_properties.event_id: Unique event identifier; retries reuse the same logical identifier.
common_properties.received_at: UTC ISO-8601 ingestion time for latency checks.
common_properties.schema_version: Version of the project event schema.
common_properties.source: Declared producer, such as client, assignment system, application server, or verified billing event.
common_properties.unit_id: Pseudonymous eligible unit; type must match the analysis definition.
common_properties.variant_id: Stable assigned variant when enrolled; do not infer from purchase choice.
common_properties.route: Sanitized path without personal query parameters.
common_properties.plan_id: Stable verified catalog identifier when applicable.
common_properties.billing_interval: Actual interval, distinct from monthly-equivalent presentation.
common_properties.currency: ISO currency code when an amount is recorded.
common_properties.amount_minor_units: Integer in the currency's documented minor unit when relevant; no implicit currency conversion.
common_properties.cohort_entered_at: Timestamp of the predefined cohort entry when applicable.
common_properties.provider: Verified billing provider identifier when an outcome is provider-backed.
common_properties.transaction_id: Stable provider transaction or invoice outcome identifier; not a webhook delivery identifier.
common_properties.subscription_id: Stable provider subscription identifier when applicable.
common_properties.effective_at: UTC ISO-8601 time the accepted subscription change takes effect.

events.name: experiment_assigned
events.notes: Keep assignment stable; retain intended allocation and pre-exposure eligibility.

events.name: experiment_exposed
events.trigger: The unit has the predefined opportunity to receive its treatment
events.notes: Use equivalent opportunity rules across variants; do not require a treatment-influenced downstream click.

events.name: pricing_viewed
events.notes: Diagnostic; not a paid conversion. Deduplicate to the agreed unit/window for rates.

events.name: plan_selected
events.trigger: Explicit user plan or interval selection
events.notes: Selection can change; preserve it through signup and checkout without trusting client amounts.

events.name: activation_completed
events.trigger: Project-defined first meaningful value task completes
events.notes: A login or tutorial completion is not automatically product value.

events.name: checkout_started
events.trigger: Valid checkout session or order is created
events.notes: Diagnostic only; not paid and not sufficient to grant paid access.

events.name: purchase_completed
events.trigger: The declared first positive-value paid outcome is confirmed
events.counting_rule: Count each eligible unit at most once for a first-paid conversion within the predefined window.
events.notes: Exclude trial starts and zero invoices; do not emit solely from a redirect or thank-you page. Reconcile outcome and net revenue separately from raw event delivery.

events.name: subscription_renewed
events.trigger: A later recurring billing outcome is confirmed
events.notes: Separate from acquisition conversion; distinguish paid renewal from scheduled renewal.

events.name: subscription_expanded
events.trigger: Existing account increases defined recurring value
events.notes: Normalize interval; exclude duplicate deliveries, migrations without economic increase and new accounts.

events.name: refund_issued
events.trigger: Refund is confirmed under the provider's documented semantics
events.notes: Reconcile partial/full refunds and attribution; do not subtract the same refund twice.

events.name: cancellation_requested
events.trigger: A cancellation request is durably accepted
events.notes: Record immediate versus period-end behavior; do not equate request date with lost access.

events.name: subscription_ended
events.trigger: Subscription ends under the declared policy
events.notes: Distinguish voluntary cancellation, failed-payment churn, and migration.

validity_checks: Deduplicate at both event delivery and business outcome levels.
Reconcile paid counts and amounts to billing records.
Inspect intended/observed assignment and exposure ratios.
Check identity collisions, cross-domain redirects and account merges.
Check missing events and consent-related coverage by variant.
Keep cohorts equally mature and compare within declared windows.
Test retries, duplicate/out-of-order delivery, pending payments, refunds and entitlement state.
Document unavailable data instead of filling it with assumed values.
